calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue up 9.62% YoY to INR 4,300 crore and EBITDA margin 3.99% vs 2.08%, but order inflow of INR 5,417 crore is thin against a INR 93,492 crore book and management guides ~15% revenue growth with no capacity or capex signal.

calls.name: Data Patterns (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Fresh order inflows FY27 over and above negotiated: around INR2,000 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR116 cr (+17% YoY) and EBITDA margin 27% against 35-40% guidance; order book INR920 cr with INR1,726 cr negotiated but unconverted, so supply-side visibility rests on unsigned orders.
calls.top: Order book INR920 cr vs negotiated INR1,726 cr unconverted

calls.name: Campus Activewear Ltd
calls.gLine: Volume growth FY27: high single digits (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 growth of 12.2% rests on pricing and channel-accounting shifts; management is building festive inventory at record production, with volume tapering and no capacity addition signalled beyond ramp-ups.

calls.name: Delhivery Ltd
calls.gLine: Local (intra-city) ARR exit: 250 Cr original target, now 160-175 Cr (FY27)
calls.thesis: Delhivery Q1 FY27: revenue ~Rs3,000 Cr (+28% YoY) with PTL yield up to ~Rs12/kg and FY27 guidance narrowed to 20-30% growth, but profitability hit by two new contracts and labour costs; supply-side signals are light.

calls.name: Syrma SGS Technology Ltd
calls.gLine: PCB project commercial production: by April 2027 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 1,604 cr (+67% YoY) and PAT +112%, but working capital days rose 63 to 71 on strategic inventory build amid supply-chain constraints; capacity utilisation 65-70%, so supply discipline is not the story.

calls.name: Tracxn Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: Top-line growth FY27: 15–20%, likely towards the higher end (FY27)
calls.thesis: Tracxn Q1 FY27 shows a demand-side re-acceleration story: revenue up 2.9% QoQ with international ARR up 4.4% QoQ, but margins still negative and no capacity or supply signals; the evidence is management narrative, not yet in reported numbers.

calls.name: Uniparts India Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: a couple of percentage points above FY26 growth of 21% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR347 crore (+27% YoY), EBITDA INR90 crore (~26% margin); no capacity additions discussed beyond maintenance-type capex of INR12 crore, growth driven by construction and new wins, with FY27 growth guided a few points above FY26's 21%.

calls.name: AVG Logistics Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 capex: INR50 crores plus; further ~INR60 crores referenced (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +6% to INR132.48 cr but PAT +30% to INR6.46 cr; FY27 guide of 15-20% growth rests on fleet adds and a new contract pipeline, with no utilisation or pricing disclosure.

calls.name: RBZ Jewellers Ltd
calls.gLine: Store break-even: capex break-even in a year or less
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR121 crore (+60% YoY) and EBITDA margin 14.9%, but factory runs at ~50% utilisation and management is expanding stores (INR10 crore Surat capex) and shifting to gold metal loans, with EBITDA margin pressure and no segment profit disclosure.
calls.top: Gold metal loan shift to hedge inventory

calls.name: Suraksha Diagnostic Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin FY27: not below 34% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Diagnostics network expanding with 21% revenue growth and 36% EBITDA margin, but growth is volume-led on new centres; no capacity discipline signal, with 100-centre FY28 target and 50-50 new-territory push.
calls.top: New centres under 2 yrs at 6.5% margin

calls.name: Inventurus Knowledge Solutions Ltd
calls.gLine: Blended EBITDA margin: early-to-mid 30s, back from 26-27% pro forma (next couple of years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR893 cr (+12% cc) and 33% reported EBITDA (35% ex-acquisition costs), but TruBridge revenue reset to ~$300m from $340m with EBITDA held at ~$68m; no numeric TruBridge growth guidance.

calls.name: Ventive Hospitality Ltd
calls.gLine: Maldives margin recovery: Q3/Q4 to offset Q1-Q2 fuel hit (FY27)
calls.thesis: Hospitality revenue up 9% to INR420 crores with India EBITDA up 16%; reported consolidated EBITDA fell about INR16 crores on Maldives diesel spike, with 1.2x net debt/EBITDA and no new capacity commitments beyond the pipeline.

calls.name: Dr. Agarwals Health Care Ltd
calls.thesis: Greenfield-led eye-care network adding 18 facilities in Q1 (16 surgical) with revenue +26% YoY to INR614 crore; supply expansion is aggressive, so the read is growth-positive but capital-intensive, not a capex-discipline story.

calls.name: Regaal Resources Ltd
calls.gLine: Crushing volume FY27: above 400,000 tons (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 operating income fell 18% to Rs 202 crore on exit from low-margin trading, while value-added margin rose to 39.8% and utilisation was 71.4% on a doubled 1,650 TPD crushing plant; net debt Rs 735 crore with inventory-heavy working capital.

calls.name: Tenneco Clean Air India Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 capex: INR350-450 crore (indicative) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 VAR up 18.4% to INR13,816m but EBITDA margin fell to 17.9% on non-indexed commodity inflation; capacity tight (ART above 90%, CAPT above 80%) with capex INR350-450 crore indicative.

calls.name: Ester Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 debt repayment: around INR100 crores
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated EBITDA up 103% to INR58.9 crore with film EBIT margin 9.8% and utilisation 84%, but management withheld firm FY27 guidance and Specialty Polymers revenue fell; other income flatters PAT.

calls.name: Kirloskar Ferrous Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Casting volume growth: 15%+ overall; castings 17-20% (remaining 3 quarters of FY27)
calls.thesis: Casting volumes up 19% and pig iron output up 5% with pricing improving, but tube sales down 14% and power-cost regulation hurting; supply additions are heavy and capex guided to Rs 600-700 crore this year.

calls.name: Greaves Cotton Ltd
calls.gLine: GEML EBITDA positive: Possibly positive in next 4 to 6 quarters (4-6 quarters)
calls.thesis: Consolidated revenue up 31% to INR975 crore but margins down 2-2.5 pts on commodity inflation and Greaves.Next spend; management guides Q2 marginally better, H2 better, full-year margin held.
calls.top: Margins down 2-2.5 pts on input costs

calls.name: Sagar Cements Ltd
calls.gLine: Volume growth FY28: double-digit (FY28)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volume up ~13% but EBITDA/tonne fell to ₹451 on West Asia energy costs; management still reiterates ₹500–550/t for FY27 and 7 Mt volumes, with no new capex through FY28.

calls.name: Finkurve Financial Services Ltd
calls.gLine: Lending yield: stabilise around 20% to 20.5%, ~50 bps uplift (FY27)
calls.thesis: Gold lender grew AUM 135% YoY but leverage rose from 0.7x to 2.9x D/E and ROA fell to 2.9%; management guides 50-60% AUM growth and yields ~20%, with gold-price-driven ticket size shrinkage and no supply-side capacity discipline discussed.
calls.top: Ticket size shrinking with gold price

calls.name: Elgi Equipments Ltd
calls.gLine: Tariff/price recovery: Price correction to flow towards end of Q2 and fully in Q3
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up ~23% (7pts FX) and EBITDA up 28%, with growth mostly volume-led; raw material up 5-6% vs 3-4% assumed, with price correction only from late Q2 and fully in Q3.

calls.name: TCPL Packaging Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 non-separator capex: INR 100-150 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 with PAT up ~79% to INR 40 crore and volumes up high single digit, but management is pivoting capex into a new battery separator venture (INR 125 crore) while folding carton utilisation is only ~70%-plus.

calls.name: Marksans Pharma Ltd
calls.gLine: QliniQ FY27 revenue: INR150-175 crores
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR841 cr (+35.6% YoY) and EBITDA margin 25.3%, but management says gross margin normalises to 55-56% and FY27 guidance is held at 15-20% growth and 20-21% EBITDA margin.

calls.name: Hikal Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: 14% to 16% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 403 cr, EBITDA margin 9.2%, Pharma EBIT margin 3.2% at ~55-60% utilisation; crop volumes recovering but China pricing pressure persists and FY27 guide of 14-16% growth and 25-30% EBITDA growth is back-half weighted.
calls.top: Crop pricing under pressure from China

calls.name: Goodluck India Ltd
calls.gLine: Standalone capex FY27-28: INR100-150 crore
calls.thesis: Standalone volume +8.8% to 122,718 t at 98% utilisation, but management pushed Defence expansion 6-9 months and gave no numbers on the cut-off; the consolidated EBITDA +46% is Defence-led and the capital story is diluted by subsidiary stake sale.

calls.name: Apollo Pipes Ltd
calls.gLine: Q2 volume growth YoY: double-digit (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volume flat YoY with consol normalised EBITDA 7% after inventory write-downs; management guides Q2 double-digit YoY growth and 7-8% margin, while capex is trimmed to about Rs.200 crores over two years.
calls.top: PVC prices fell Rs.32/kg in April

calls.name: Allcargo Logistics Ltd
calls.gLine: Express pre-Ind AS operating PBT margin FY27: 5% to 6%
calls.thesis: Allcargo Q1 FY27 revenue up 11.2% to INR546 cr with Express yield up 6.4% and volume up 6.7%, but the supply side is unchanged: no capacity addition or capex cut, just INR10-15 cr express upkeep and ~INR20 cr CL capex.

calls.name: Lumax Auto Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: Mechatronics revenue FY27: around INR 400 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR 1,364 crore (+33% y-o-y) and EBITDA margin 15.1% (+190 bps); management held FY27 guidance and capex at about INR 300 crore, with no explicit capacity-cut or discipline signals.

calls.name: Sejal Glass Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin improvement: ~1% over upcoming quarters (upcoming quarters)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR117.95 cr (+52.9% YoY) with PAT ~6.5%, but India utilisation is low (Taloja 55%, Erode 15%) and management guides FY27 revenue growth of 25%+ with PAT margin of 9-10% back-half weighted.

calls.name: Sunrakshakk Industries India Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: INR900-1,000 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 120.6% YoY to INR276.33 cr but consolidated EBITDA margin fell to 8.18% from 10.19% QoQ on raw-material and crude-linked cost pressure; management guides ~6% FY27 PAT margin and says utilisation is only 50-55%.

calls.name: Apollo Micro Systems Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue INR156 crore (+17% YoY) with 31% EBITDA margin, but guidance is 40-45% growth and the order-book upside rests on QRSAM, MIGM and Pinaka orders not yet placed; no capacity discipline signal.

calls.name: MSTC Ltd
calls.gLine: TReDS platform operationalisation: Within FY27, subject to RBI approval (FY27)
calls.thesis: MSTC's Q1 FY27 e-commerce revenue rose to Rs 89.49 crore (vs Rs 70.03 crore), but no supply-side capacity signal exists; the asset-light auction platform's growth relies on scrap cycles and unapproved new verticals (EPR, TReDS) awaiting regulatory go-aheads.
calls.top: E-commerce revenue Rs 89.49 cr vs Rs 70.03 cr

calls.name: Metro Brands Ltd
calls.gLine: E-commerce growth: 20% to 30% healthy
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone sales +9% with SOR 3P drag and April–May softness, June recovered to mid-teens; gross margin near 60%, EBITDA ~30%, PAT guidance held at 13–15% with no supply-side signals.
calls.top: June growth mid-teens after soft Apr–May

calls.name: Keystone Realtors Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 pre-sales INR 617 cr and collections INR 599 cr (97% efficiency), EBITDA margin 21.3%, but OCF only INR 68 cr against INR 1,000 cr FY guidance; supply-side signals are mainly launch pipeline and land spend.
calls.top: OCF INR 68 cr vs INR 1,000 cr FY guide

calls.name: Yatharth Hospital & Trauma Care Services Ltd
calls.gLine: Bed capacity: 5,000 beds in ~2.5 years (~FY29)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR3,927m (+51% YoY) and ARPOB INR34,758 (+7%), but occupancy ~75% on a census-bed base that rose 1,655→1,820 and new hospitals still dilute margins (consolidated EBITDA 23.3%).
calls.top: Capex per bed INR75-80 lakh for 1,800 beds

calls.name: INOX India Ltd
calls.gLine: Order inflow: slightly above INR450-500 cr per quarter (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record INR532 cr order inflow and INR1,686 cr order book, but Q1 revenue of INR382 cr missed the INR410-415 cr target and EBITDA grew only 1.4%; mgmt reiterates 18-20% FY27 growth.

calls.name: Happy Forgings Ltd
calls.gLine: Industrial share of revenue (medium term): Industrials to double in 3-4 years; PV 12-15%; industrials+PV 45-50% of revenue (3-4 years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs449cr (+27%) and EBITDA margin 31.3%, but forging utilisation only 59% with 4,000t press added; price hikes of ~4.5-5% on domestic book start from Q2.

calls.name: EPACK Durable Ltd
calls.gLine: AC industry growth FY27: ~20%, EPACK to outgrow
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up ~34% to INR886 cr with RAC volume up ~30%, but EBITDA margin fell to 6.21% (6.4% underlying ex-PLI) on forex loss and wage costs; utilisation guided to 55-60% and capex only INR60-70 cr more.

calls.name: Capital Small Finance Bank Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 small finance bank with 22% advances growth, NIM up to 4.21% and PAT up 29%, but no supply-side levers; growth is loan-led and profitability gains rely on deposit repricing that management says is largely done.

calls.name: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Ltd
calls.thesis: Niva Bupa's combined ratio improved to 100.2% from 103.2% on a 3.8pt loss-ratio drop, but group book is flat and management admits B2B pricing is claims-minus; FY29 mid-to-high-teens ROE reiterated.

calls.name: One Mobikwik Systems Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 PAT: INR40 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 PAT ₹7.6 cr on payments GP ₹77 cr and lending GP ₹43 cr, but payments revenue dipped as card-linked categories were paused; UPI GMV is non-monetised.
calls.top: Net payments take rate 12-14 bps guided

calls.name: Ivalue Infosolutions Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 gross sales up 5.7% to INR 641 crore with PAT up 52%, but growth is lumpy and management reaffirmed 20% FY27 growth without supply-side evidence; ILM down about 60% as budgets shifted to DCI.

calls.name: Trualt Bioenergy Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 ethanol sales volume: ~44 crore litres (order book)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 ethanol volumes ~8.3-8.5 crore litres on ~60% utilisation with a 44 crore litre FY27 order book, but margins rest on cheap grain inventory that management says will fade at INR25.50/kg maize.
calls.top: Maize at INR25.50 squeezes margin to INR6-7/litre

calls.name: Fujiyama Power Systems Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: 70% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 125% to Rs 13,457m and EBITDA margin 18.9%, but supply-side evidence is mostly capacity additions (3.5GW panels, 4GW power electronics) with utilisation of new Ratlam plant only 40-50% and a Rs 1,436m fire loss.

calls.name: Wakefit Innovations Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex FY27: Rs 100–120 cr (FY27)
calls.thesis: Wakefit Q1 FY27 revenue +16.6% to Rs 405 cr with gross margin 57.1%, but management flags ~100 bps gross-margin compression in H1 from raw-material (polyol/TDI) inflation and capex of Rs 100–120 cr is mostly store rollout, not capacity.

calls.name: Hexagon Nutrition Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 20% to 25% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +43% to INR104.3 cr but EBITDA margin fell to 11.3% from 13.8% on raw-material and freight costs; capacity utilisation rose to 47% from ~30%, while inventory days climbed to ~142 from ~130.

calls.name: Susan Electricals India Ltd
calls.gLine: HT & MVCC share of revenue: ~15% by year-end, ~50% by end FY27 (inconsistent) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 279% to ₹95.36 Cr with PAT ₹6.39 Cr, but the transcript is internally inconsistent on HT/MVCC share (5-10% vs 10-15% vs ~50% target) and product margins, and capex is only ₹15-20 Cr against a claimed 60% capacity add.

calls.name: Caliber Mining And Logistics Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 45% to 50% YoY (FY27)
calls.thesis: Coal mining and logistics contractor: revenue up ~67% YoY to INR657 cr, but reported EBITDA margin fell to 16.8% (20.0% adjusted vs ~24% a year ago) on diesel spike; FY27 guide 45–50% revenue growth, 35%+ EBITDA growth.

calls.name: Kanohar Electricals Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue FY27: approximately INR950 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue ₹137.1 cr (+103.5% YoY) and EBITDA margin 28.3%, but no capacity cut or discipline signal; 18,000 MVA brownfield added for FY29 with ~1,725 MVA executed in Q1 on 19,200 MVA base.

calls.name: Exide Industries Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue +17.6% and EBITDA margin 12.4% (+20bp YoY) on broad volume growth; lithium-ion ramp is the main capex story with utilisation guided at 25-30% and Rs1,400 cr FY27 capex approved.

calls.name: Escorts Kubota Ltd
calls.gLine: Tractor industry FY27 volume: mid-single-digit growth
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volume strong (domestic tractors +22.9%, share +36bp) but EBITDA margin fell to 11.2% from 13.1% on ~5% commodity cost hit; price hikes lag cost, Q2 cost pressure of 1.5-2% more, FY27 industry guided mid-single-digit growth.

calls.name: Zuari Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Zuari Agro ICD repayment: INR258 crore in current quarter (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Zuari Q1 FY27 standalone EBITDA fell to INR31.3 cr from INR36.9 cr and PAT was a loss of INR9.5 cr; profit depends on Dubai repatriation (INR142 cr received of ~INR900 cr guided) and a sugar price rally that is not yet in the numbers.
calls.top: Sugar prices up 10% in a month

calls.name: TIL Ltd
calls.gLine: Turnover growth: Significant jump this year; tripling in 5-7 years (FY27 and 5-7 years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue INR117.1 cr (+86%) with partial Tulip consolidation; standalone EBITDA margin 4.3% and management sees no margin fix for six to eight quarters, with no capex beyond bridging.
calls.top: Debtor days stressed after March billing

calls.name: Adf Foods Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 25.9% to INR167.3 cr but EBITDA margin 17.7% flattered by INR19.7 cr US tariff refund; freight cost ~3% of revenue, and Surat plant only ~30% utilised this year.
calls.top: 30% of ready goods unshipped in June

calls.name: Viceroy Hotels Ltd
calls.gLine: Courtyard occupancy: 80% to 85% over next 2 FYs (FY27-FY28)
calls.thesis: Hotel-owner Viceroy Q1 FY27 revenue up 77% to INR44.9 cr and EBITDA margin 26.3%, but PAT just INR1.4 cr as finance cost quadrupled; supply is expanding (Phase 2 Marriott rooms offline, Greenfield 200-key) with no capacity discipline.

calls.name: LT Foods Ltd
calls.gLine: Organic EBITDA margin: 7% to 8% by end of FY27
calls.thesis: Headline revenue up 26% to INR3,161 cr but PAT up only 9% and EBITDA margin fell to 11.5% from 12.1%; organic segment at 4% EBITDA margin is the drag, with management guiding a recovery to 7-8% by year end.

calls.name: PPAP Automotive Ltd
calls.gLine: Margin recovery: Improvement expected as pass-through settles by end Q2 / early Q3 (Q2-Q3 FY27)
calls.thesis: Revenue up 34.1% to INR156.4 cr and EBITDA up 33.3% to INR12.4 cr, but margins are under raw-material pressure with only ~2% of a ~4% input rise passed through; utilisation is 73%, so no supply discipline signal.

calls.name: Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys Ltd
calls.gLine: Q2 realisation: similar to Q1, slight correction (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 on ~80,000t output and ~INR120,000/t realisation, but FY27 volume guidance cut from 400,000t to ~380,000t on transformer and gas-cleaning constraints at KNR-2; Q2 prices guided flat to slightly lower.

calls.name: Health X Platform Ltd
calls.gLine: RetailerShakti EBITDA: positive EBITDA in Q3 FY27 (Q3 FY27)
calls.thesis: Health X grew revenue 58% YoY to INR440 crores with EBITDA still negative at -3.4% margin and gross margin 7.8%; management refuses EBITDA focus and gives no segment P&L, with no capacity-discipline or pricing evidence.

calls.name: Texmaco Rail & Engineering Ltd
calls.gLine: Core EBITDA margin: 1.2% to 3% in 1-3 years (1-3 years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell to INR753 crore on weaker freight car execution, with EBITDA margin 10.8% and order book INR9,923 crore; supply-side signals are mixed, with freight car output of 1,054 units and no capacity commentary.
