calls.name: Anand Rathi Wealth Ltd
calls.gLine: AUM growth: 20%-25% per year over 3-4 years (3-4 years)
calls.thesis: Wealth manager reports 24% PAT growth (ex-fair-value) to INR116 crores with 1.1 lakh crore AUM, but supply-side levers are absent and about a quarter of the FY27 guidance is a function of mark-to-market gains.
calls.top: AMC licence application approved by Board

calls.name: Bikaji Foods International Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: mid-teens to ~16%+ growth, delivered quarter-on-quarter
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue grew ~12.5% on 7.7% volume, but a 3-4 day plant/dispatch outage and labour exodus hit April-May, EBITDA margin ~13.5%, and management guides FY27 margin 13-13.5% with no new price hikes until Diwali.

calls.name: Ideaforge Technology Ltd
calls.gLine: Order book execution: INR256.8 cr delivered by Q3 FY27 (Q3 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR68.6 cr (vs 12.8 cr) with EBITDA INR4.3 cr positive; order book INR256.8 cr to be executed by Q3, but no capacity additions and most FTP order inflows slipping to H2 or FY28.
calls.top: Order book INR256.8 cr to execute by Q3

calls.name: Rishabh Instruments Ltd
calls.gLine: Lumel Alucast adjusted EBITDA: breakeven for full year (end FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue up 4.2% to INR1,983m but EEI up 34% with ~24% margin; supply-side evidence is capacity expansion (CT capacity nearly doubling, Nashik plant), not discipline, and Lumel Alucast still loss-making.

calls.name: Indegene Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: 19% to 20% in H2 FY27; back by Q4 FY27 (Q4 FY27)
calls.thesis: Indegene Q1 FY27 revenue up 26.5% YoY in USD to $112.5m with EBITDA 16.9%; management reiterates 19–20% margin recovery by Q4 FY27, but this is a services firm with no capacity data and it is a services/pharma commercial business, so the capital-cycle read is thin.
calls.top: Margin recovery to 19–20% by Q4 FY27

calls.name: TBO TEK Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 margin expansion came from operating leverage on a travel platform with no capacity cycle; Middle East flat, Europe +24%, and management gave no hard numeric guidance beyond "QoQ and YoY growth" aims.
calls.top: Take rate lower in tough quarter

calls.name: Black Buck Ltd
calls.thesis: Platform growth steady (revenue from ops +42% YoY, adj EBITDA ₹55 cr +16%), but supply-side signals are absent; super loads still in heavy investment phase and fuel recovery uncertain.

calls.name: Sai Life Sciences Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 12% to INR553 crore with CRO +26% and CDMO only +6%; management keeps 15-20% mid-term growth and INR1,100-1,300 crore capex, with H2 weighted to new Bidar capacity.

calls.name: Travel Food Services Ltd
calls.thesis: Travel F&B operator grew system-wide sales 18% and PAT 35.6% on flat traffic, but LFL slowed to 0.8% (7% ex-disrupted markets) and EBITDA margin fell to 35.8% on pre-opening costs for 87 new outlets.

calls.name: Pace Digitek Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA/PAT margin BESS: PAT 10.5%-11% (FY27)
calls.thesis: BESS capacity doubles to 10 GWh by December while bidding discipline reportedly returns; FY27 revenue guidance Rs 3,200-3,400 crore held, but Q1 revenue of Rs 555 crore needs ~Rs 2,700 crore in remaining quarters and operating cash flow remains negative.

calls.name: MV Electrosystems Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: INR400 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Post-IPO rail propulsion ramp from ~10 units in September to ~40/month by January on a 564-unit order book (INR989 crore); no deliveries in the prior two months, so the thesis rests on unproven execution.

calls.name: Amara Raja Energy & Mobility Ltd
calls.gLine: Further price hikes: 2% to 3% in current month (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up ~24% to INR4,215 cr but consolidated margin fell to 9.6% as raw-material and strategic spend hit; price hikes of ~3% in June plus 2-3% planned lag pass-through, and capex of INR1,700 cr is largely new energy.

calls.name: Chambal Fertilisers & Chemicals Ltd
calls.gLine: NPK tie-up volume: 8.5 lakh tons tied up with vendors
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA rose 12% to INR 851 crores on margin of ~17% despite revenue down 12%, but urea volumes fell on Gadepan shutdowns and a new 4th urea plant (~INR 10,000 crore) hinges on a government bid process due around October.

calls.name: Great Eastern Shipping Company Ltd
calls.thesis: Record quarter on Hormuz-driven tanker spike, but management is holding cash, replacing rather than expanding fleet, and says new orderbook is rising (crude tankers 27%) so supply risk is building.

calls.name: GlaxoSmithKline Pharmaceuticals Ltd
calls.gLine: Sustainable growth in general medicines and vaccines: 8% to 10% (medium term)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 sales up 15% to INR924 cr (about 9-10% underlying ex-CMO base), PAT up 24% (17% ex one-off), volume +3-3.5%, price ~6%; opex spike to be front-loaded and moderate.
calls.top: Innovation sales 7% of revenue vs 4% last year

calls.name: Castrol India Ltd
calls.thesis: Castrol India Q2 CY26 revenue INR1,871 crore (+25% YoY) and EBITDA margin ~26%, helped by one-off benefit from cheaper inventory; management says costs hit P&L more in Q3 and pricing is the lever, with a 21-24% EBITDA band.
calls.top: Old low-cost inventory flattered Q2 margin

calls.name: Jagsonpal Pharmaceuticals Ltd
calls.gLine: Aequitas EBITDA: Rs.10 crore by year two (two years post-integration)
calls.thesis: Jagsonpal Q1 FY27 revenue up ~9% to Rs.82 crore with EBITDA up ~21%, but no capacity or utilisation data; the Aequitas hospital push (Rs.10 crore EBITDA target in year two) rests on management assertion.
calls.top: Aequitas Rs.10 crore EBITDA by year two

calls.name: Ugro Capital Ltd
calls.gLine: Closing AUM FY27: flat
calls.thesis: Opex cut to ~INR 119 cr/qtr (from 217) and ~INR 2,551 cr disbursements, but on-book interest income fell 13% QoQ and co-lending/DA income halved to INR 75 cr; capital-cycle reset is real yet earnings quality still in transition.

calls.name: Symphony Ltd
calls.gLine: Australia capital deployment: No further capital allocation
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consol EBITDA ex one-offs up 39% to ₹53 crore with channel inventory cleared, but management warns of near-term margin pressure from elevated input costs and only partial price pass-through.

calls.name: Blue Dart Express Ltd
calls.thesis: Blue Dart's Q1 FY27 growth was mostly yield-led: tonnage up ~7% and shipments ~2%, with management citing GPI and loss-lane price corrections, while air volume grew only ~2.6% and no capacity guidance was given.

calls.name: KRBL Ltd
calls.gLine: Masala annualised revenue run rate: approximately INR25 crores by end FY27 (end FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 profit was a record on price hikes and investment MTM gains, not sustainable; Middle East exports fell about 50% to INR244 crore while guidance was held and FY27 gross margin is pegged at about 30%.

calls.name: R Systems International Ltd
calls.thesis: Revenue Rs 601.7 cr (+30.2% YoY, +4.7% QoQ) with adjusted EBITDA margin 20.1%, but organic growth is muted and management gives no numeric guidance; growth is largely acquisition and rupee aided.

calls.name: Sutlej Textiles and Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Interest outflow FY27: about INR75 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin rose to 6.7% from 0.8% a year ago on mix and integration, but management gave no capacity data, no utilisation and only qualitative guidance; capex is maintenance-led with interest outflow guided up to about INR75 crores.

calls.name: Kiri Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Copper tube plant start: 35 KT operational June 2027 (FY28)
calls.thesis: Dyes realisations drove standalone revenue up 63% to INR 295 cr and material margin to 31.9%, but PAT of INR 270 cr was mostly treasury/other income; copper project remains capital-heavy and pre-revenue.
calls.top: FY28 INR 20,000-25,000 cr revenue guidance dropped

calls.name: Fredun Pharmaceuticals Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue FY27: ~INR800 crores ("somewhere around") (FY27)
calls.thesis: Consumer-pharma growth story with no capacity-discipline or pricing evidence; Q1 FY27 revenue up ~90% on pre-booked orders, FY27 target ~INR800 crores, management guidance is qualitative and promotional.

calls.name: Dilip Buildcon Ltd
calls.gLine: Working capital days year-end: about 120
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone EBITDA margin 10.32% and order inflow only Rs 268 crores; management holds FY27 order guidance of Rs 10,000-12,000 crores and debt cut of Rs 600-800 crores, while standalone net debt rose to Rs 2,106 crores.

calls.name: Indigo Paints Ltd
calls.thesis: Indigo Paints grew standalone revenue 18.7% with volumes up double digits and EBITDA margin up to 17.7%, but management says Q2 growth will be pushed harder via trade and influencer spend and gives no margin guidance.
calls.top: Capex cycle closed; no major capex for 3 years

calls.name: Craftsman Automation Ltd
calls.gLine: Sunbeam Q4 EBITDA margin: mid-teens (Q4 FY27)
calls.thesis: Capex rising to ~INR 1,500 cr (standalone ~1,000 + DR Axion 430 + Sunbeam maintenance) with Powertrain at ~70% utilisation and Aluminium above 80%; supply expansion is management's own call, with Hosur capacity pending orders.

calls.name: Nazara Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: NODWIN organic growth FY27: 30%+
calls.thesis: Gaming revenue up 14% to INR 275 crore with 19.5% EBITDA margin, but margins are deferred by UA spend and Bluetile margin fell to ~11%; the $303m all-cash Bluetile deal and a funding gap make this a capital-allocation story rather than supply-discipline.

calls.name: Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences Ltd
calls.gLine: ARPOB growth: 4-5% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR 1,196 crore (+36% YoY) with IP volumes +26.6%, but Kondapur ramp, new-unit losses and a 50% occupancy base keep supply absorption the key test; ARPOB guided to 4-5% growth.

calls.name: CMS Info Systems Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: about 27% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 services revenue INR625cr, INR25cr short of plan from a cash supply squeeze (currency fulfilment ~70% then ~80%); FY27 revenue guide trimmed but EBITDA margin guide raised to ~27%.

calls.name: Vedant Fashions Ltd
calls.gLine: Full-year SSG: high single-digit SSG for balance 9 months (analyst framing, management said 'fair understanding')
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 SSG +3.8% with EBITDA margin 44.6% and store closures accelerated, but management sees competitor store exits in 8 states and guides to a stronger H2 with net positive year; no numeric guidance given.

calls.name: Aether Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 capex: INR3,000-3,500 million
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 27% to INR3,266m and EBITDA margin 31%, but LSM volumes fell 22.5% as lines were moved to CEM, and capex guided to INR3,000-3,500m for Site 5 and R&D.

calls.name: Modis Navnirman Ltd
calls.gLine: Redevelopment projects to add: two to three projects in this year
calls.thesis: Mumbai redevelopment developer: Q1 FY27 revenue up 27.9% YoY to INR58.26 cr, but EBITDA margin fell from ~22.3% to ~19.8% on war-driven material and labour cost hits; no capacity or capital-cycle signals.

calls.name: KFin Technologies Ltd
calls.industry: Depositories, Clearing Houses and Other Intermediaries
calls.gLine: EBITDA growth FY27: 17% to 20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 30% YoY (ex-Ascent ~10%) but EBITDA margin fell to 34.2% with Ascent (39.4% ex-Ascent); yield down ~2% QoQ on debt-to-liquid shift and a provisioned renegotiation.

calls.name: SBFC Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: Branch additions: 10-15 branches in FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: SBFC held spreads at 9.48% (+39 bps QoQ) and ROE at 14.73%, but AUM growth slowed to 6% QoQ, 0+ DPD rose 70 bps, and management is cautious on sub-10 lakh borrower leverage.

calls.name: DOMS Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin (guided range): about 16% to 17% (FY28 onward)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +19.2% to INR670 cr but EBITDA margin fell to 12.3% from 17.6% on ~400bp gross margin hit; management prioritises volume over price and sees no further hikes this quarter.

calls.name: Medi Assist Healthcare Services Ltd
calls.gLine: Paramount claims migration: balance claims and operations on Medi Assist stack within Q2 FY27 (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 operating EBITDA margin 20.3% (up from 17.1% in Q2) with revenue up 24.1% and retention at 90.2%, but no capacity or capex angle; margin recovery to ~23% is pushed to end-FY27.

calls.name: Awfis Space Solutions Ltd
calls.gLine: Gross seat additions FY27: 22,000 to 25,000 seats (FY27)
calls.thesis: Flex operator growing revenue 27% with occupancy flat at 76% and cash EBITDA margin only 10.1%; supply growth is mostly leased, not owned, so capital-light claims rest on lease-cost pass-through timing.

calls.name: Emcure Pharmaceuticals Ltd
calls.gLine: Net debt by end Q2 FY27: close to INR 1,450 crore
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +22.8% to INR 2,580 cr with international +34.2% carrying growth; India only +10.2% and management guides India acceleration without capacity or supply-side signals.

calls.name: Ceigall India Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: minimum 15% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue up 10.2% to INR901 cr and EBITDA margin 13.4%, but order inflow only ~INR600 cr against a INR6,000 cr annual target and HAM equity needs rising to INR859 cr this year.
calls.top: Order inflow ~INR600 cr vs INR6,000 cr target

calls.name: Orient Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: Annuity revenue share: 51% target in about three years (3 years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 margin recovery to 7.57% EBITDA on revenue of Rs 201.92 cr (+9.7% QoQ), but management gave no numeric guidance, annuity mix only 23%, and call includes unverified figures and an evasive, promotional tone.

calls.name: Midwest Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: INR840 crores (granite 720, quartz 100-120)
calls.thesis: Granite-led quarter with revenue up 35% YoY, but quartz Phase 1 sold only ~5,000 tons with FY27 quartz volume guidance cut from 150,000 to 120,000 tons and EBITDA margin hit by diesel.

calls.name: Allcargo Global Ltd
calls.gLine: Cost base (employee and admin) in USD terms: flat over coming couple of years
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA turned to INR33 crore from a INR17 crore Q4 and a loss last year, but volumes are still below prior levels and management gave no hard numbers beyond a flat dollar cost intent.
calls.top: LCL and air volumes up about 5% QoQ

calls.name: Amagi Media Labs Ltd
calls.gLine: Gross margin: 67% to 69% for this year (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR 437 cr (+32% YoY, record) with adj. EBITDA margin 11.5% and ~31% incremental flow-through; no capacity or capex signals, and gross margin guided 67-69% with AI investment dragging.

calls.name: GSP Crop Science Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth (medium term): around 15% (medium term)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue steady at INR386 cr (vs 377 cr) with PAT up ~16% to INR26.4 cr, but growth aided by a one-off land sale (~INR5.7 cr other income) and management gave no numeric capacity-discipline signal; utilisation of technical plants 70-75%.

calls.name: Shiprocket Ltd
calls.thesis: Asset-light shipping and D2C enabler: core transactions +31% with core EBITDA margin 12.8% (+50bps YoY) and emerging EBITDA improving to -24% from -38%, but no capex or supply lever to read.

calls.name: John Cockerill India Ltd
calls.gLine: Operating expenses (other expenses): slightly less than current quarter's ~INR70 crore
calls.thesis: Standalone revenue ~INR149 crore (+82% YoY) but down sequentially; order book ~INR4,500 crore consolidated after ~INR1,200 crore wins, with margins hit by early-stage project costs.

calls.name: Patanjali Foods Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 29% to INR11,337 cr with EBITDA margin 4.80%, but growth is largely price-led (foods pricing ~12% vs volume ~5%), no capacity signal, and staples EBITDA negative at INR-59 cr.

calls.name: Bhagyanagar India Ltd
calls.gLine: Average realisation FY27: above Rs 1,300/kg, ~30% higher YoY (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin 5.43% and PAT margin 2.87% on 5,278 t volume (down 9.5% QoQ) as April–May supply shortage lifted realisations; management guides 5–5.5% margin and 12–15% volume growth.
calls.top: Capacity 35,000 t online; 45,000 t next year

calls.name: Baroda Extrusion Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue/profit growth FY27-28: 35% to 40% minimum rise
calls.thesis: Small copper extruder (~Rs 48 cr quarterly revenue, EBITDA margin ~7.7%) with a planned Rs 20-25 cr extrusion press expansion; management talk is heavy on vision and light on numbers, with volume and capacity figures that contradict each other.

calls.name: Hindustan Foods Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 capex projects: INR340 crores new projects plus INR150 crores carry forward (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 record PAT of INR42.8 crores (+33% YoY) with FY27 PAT guidance of INR200-220 crores reaffirmed; footwear hit ~INR6 crores and shoe utilisation was poor in Q1, though new capex of INR340 crores is announced.
calls.top: Footwear cost pass-through lag ~INR6 cr hit

calls.name: DCM Shriram Ltd
calls.gLine: Caustic soda ECU price: INR30,000 or higher
calls.thesis: Chemicals revenue up 33% with ECU up 7% and utilisation at 82%, but PVC volumes fell 25% on a duty waiver and Chinese imports; Q1 PAT ex one-offs up 28% to INR147 crore.

calls.name: Ashiana Housing Ltd
calls.gLine: ROE: floor of 15%, likely 20% this year
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell to INR107 crore from INR293 crore on handover timing, but management reiterated about INR2,000 crore FY27 revenue and INR2,200 crore presales, with Senior Living pivot and 15% ROE floor.
calls.top: Q1 bookings INR358 cr, units 407→234 YoY

calls.name: JK Tyre & Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 consolidated revenue growth: good double-digit (~10-11%) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1FY27 EBITDA margin fell to 6.8% from 10.9% on ~20% RM spike; management guides 10-11% FY27 margins and 8-9% further price hikes, but supply-side discipline is absent given Rs.4,980 crore expansion and Rs.500-700 crore debt rise.

calls.name: Emami Ltd
calls.gLine: Start-ups revenue FY27: INR750-800 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Consolidated revenue +15% to INR1,039 cr and EBITDA +6% to INR226 cr, but input costs up 360bps and management guides to offset via pricing; no supply-side capacity signal.

calls.name: Saregama India Ltd
calls.gLine: New music content spend FY27: Rs 300-350 cr (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 263.6 cr (+27% YoY), adjusted EBITDA Rs 112.4 cr (+69%); music vertical guidance of 20-23% growth and 60-65% EBITDA margin held, but no supply-side discipline evidence and content spend rising to Rs 300-350 cr.
calls.top: Music growth 20-23% and EBITDA margin 60-65% held

calls.name: Astra Microwave Products Ltd
calls.gLine: Space and Weather entity FY27 revenue: INR300-plus crore with at least 18% to 20% PBT margin (FY28 standalone entity)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue of INR182 crore was soft on customer-approval and technical delays, but a ~INR2,205 crore HAL Uttam Radar order lifts standalone order book to INR2,156 crore and FY27 revenue guidance is held at INR1,350 crore.

calls.name: Embassy Developments Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 presales ₹868 cr (+338% YoY) and collections ₹496 cr (+54%), but no launches in Q1, operating cash flow negative ₹285 cr and reported EBITDA −₹106 cr; supply-side ramp rests on Q2–Q4 launches.
calls.top: Operating cash flow −₹285 cr in Q1

calls.name: Paisalo Digital Ltd
calls.gLine: AUM, income and PAT: approximately double in 3 fiscal years (3 fiscal years)
calls.thesis: Paisalo's Q1 FY27 is a growth-led NBFC print (disbursements +128% YoY, AUM +28%) with no supply-side evidence; management guides to doubling AUM, income and PAT in three years, but leverage is rising and PAT beat hinges on a 40% cost-to-income.

calls.name: eClerx Services Ltd
calls.industry: Business Process Outsourcing (BPO)/ Knowledge Process Outsourcing (KPO)
calls.gLine: CLX revenue growth: 0% to 2% full year (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1FY27 revenue USD 125.9m, +2.8% QoQ, EBITDA margin 23% on wage hikes; FY EBITDA guided 24-28% with midpoint the realistic pick, BFSI still shrinking and utilisation 75.5%.
calls.top: BFSI flat QoQ, still shrinking YoY

calls.name: Brigade Enterprises Ltd
calls.gLine: Commercial leasing CAGR: ~20% over 5-6 years (FY31)
calls.thesis: Real estate margin rebounded to 21% (from 12%) on better-margin project recognition while sales fell 5% and launches slipped; FY27 presales guidance of INR9,000 crores held despite 9.36 msf launch pipeline shortfall.

calls.name: Jubilant FoodWorks Ltd
calls.thesis: Domino's LFL slowed to 2.5% in Q1FY27 with price hikes and LPG/cheese inflation absorbing margin; supply-side capex held at INR750-900 crore with supply chain investment past peak.

calls.name: Gujarat Energy Ltd
calls.gLine: Morbi minimum volume: 1.8-2 mmscmd floor (next quarters)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 gas-trading EBT of INR726 crores on Brent-linked contracts and Morbi volume surge; management holds INR1,100 crore FY27 trading guidance, which looks conservative against the quarter.

calls.name: Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals Ltd
calls.gLine: A&P as % of sales FY27: similar to last year
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +11.8% to Rs 2,235 cr and EBITDA margin +20 bps to 10%, but management admits ~Rs 200 cr primary sales lost to supply disruption; pricing covered ~80% of inflation and Q2 start is strong.

calls.name: Parag Milk Foods Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: more than 10% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR945 crore (+11% value, +3% volume) with EBITDA margin 7.4% vs 7.7%; no capacity-discipline signal, core flagship volumes down 2% and B2B pricing pressure acknowledged.

calls.name: Sheela Foam Ltd
calls.gLine: Overseas EBITDA: combined EBITDA around INR120 crores; revenue above INR1,000 crores
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 margin fell as raw-material volatility hit gross margin, but management leaned on foam volume and overseas gains; standalone volume only ~6% and no capacity discipline signal.

calls.name: Shalby Ltd
calls.gLine: Hospital FY27 EBITDA margin: up to 20% for full year (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated EBITDA flat at ₹49 cr on 11.6% revenue growth as margin fell to 14.5% from 16%; hospital standalone margin down to 18.4% from 21.6%, with management guiding to 20% for the full year without numbers on capacity.

calls.name: Mishra Dhatu Nigam Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: Back to 20-21% from Q3
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 turnover up 40.5% to Rs 239.5 cr but EBITDA margin fell to about 20% (vs 23% expected) on LPG and raw-material cost spikes; order book Rs 2,329 cr, 66% defence, with capex mostly deferred pending ministry approval.
calls.top: Raw-material adverse variance Rs 13 cr in Q1

calls.name: Aartech Solonics Ltd
calls.gLine: Next quarters revenue and margins: Expected to be very healthy
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue rose about 1.5x year on year to Rs 728 lakhs and PBT rose to Rs 119 lakhs from Rs 73 lakhs, but the call gave no capacity, utilisation or pricing data and pipeline conversion remained vague.

calls.name: Prince Pipes and Fittings Ltd
calls.gLine: Debtor days: 30 days target (next couple of years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volumes fell 7% YoY to 40,729 MT with utilisation only 52-53%, but margin rose to 13% on mix; management says channel restocking resumed and capacity is ahead of demand.

calls.name: Brand Concepts Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up ~11% but PBT loss widened; management says PC plant at 80%+ utilisation, PP plant ramping, and sees inventory cut to ~130 days, with capex pause for two years.

calls.name: Harsha Engineers International Ltd
calls.gLine: Advantek revenue: Rs 140 cr plus (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated engineering supply Rs 421 cr (+21% YoY) with EBITDA Rs 69.8 cr, down from Rs 77 cr QoQ on a raw-material pass-through lag; capacity expansion at Bhayla and China continues.
calls.top: Raw material up ~8% YoY, pass-through lagged

calls.name: Radiant Cash Management Services Ltd
calls.gLine: Standalone revenue growth FY27: double-digit (10-12%) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Radiant's standalone EBITDA margin fell to 13.5% from 15.9% on manpower costs, with price revisions of unspecified size only under IBA negotiation (targeted Q2); no capacity signal, and the cash-in-transit peer pricing remains unproven.

calls.name: Signatureglobal (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Land capex: Rs 15-18 billion for the year (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 pre-sales about Rs 20bn (20% of Rs 100bn FY target), collections only Rs 6.7bn, and new launches guided at Rs 150bn; supply pipeline expanding while cash conversion lags.

calls.name: Updater Services Ltd
calls.thesis: Facilities and BSS services business with 9% revenue growth to INR764 crores and 5.5% EBITDA margin; no capacity or capex story, growth is labour-led and pass-through, with weak IFM margin of 4.5%.

calls.name: Azad Engineering Ltd
calls.gLine: Debtor days (working capital): H1 ~200 days; H2 160-180 days (H1 and H2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue +26.8% YoY to INR170.5 cr and EBITDA margin 37.6%, but capacity is still ramping with revenue contribution guided only from H2; other income fell to INR4 cr from INR17 cr and receivable days are 170-180.

calls.name: Popular Vehicles and Services Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue FY27: INR8,200-8,300 crores (~20-25% growth)
calls.thesis: Dealership (auto retail) with reported revenue +44% to INR1,890 cr and EBITDA margin 3.8%; organic growth strong but no supply discipline signal, and capacity/acquisition growth is debt-funded with PAT still marginal.

calls.name: JNK India Ltd
calls.gLine: Chemdist revenue share FY27: 10% to 15% of JNK India revenue
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue up 80.6% to INR 186 cr with EBITDA margin 11.8% after Chemdist JV loss; order book INR 1,801 cr, but Q1 is seasonally 10-15% of FY revenue and the Chemdist-driven margin dip plus a cancelled export order temper the read.

calls.name: Ola Electric Mobility Ltd
calls.gLine: Opex (incl. leases) per quarter: ₹300-325 crore over next couple of quarters (next 2 quarters)
calls.thesis: Ola Electric's Q1 FY27 volumes nearly doubled QoQ to ~39,200 with auto gross margin held at 30.5%, but cell production was paused for a 2–3 month capacity install and management gave no formal guidance, so supply-side evidence is mixed.

calls.name: Brigade Hotel Ventures Ltd
calls.gLine: Minimum ADR growth at Kochi Courtyard: at least 10% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 hotel RevPAR +9% on rate (ARR +7% to INR7,241, occupancy 75.7%), profit more than doubled on debt repayment; supply is growing with 1,700 keys in pipeline, but Q1 F&B/MICE hit ~INR14 crore and management is leaning on a H2 recovery.

calls.name: Advit Jewels Ltd
calls.gLine: B2B/B2C mix target: 40% to 50% on B2B, B2C also
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 PAT up 37.9% to INR8.19 crore at 23.1% margin, but call is promotional with no capacity, utilisation or pricing data; B2C/store capex and franchise model still unformed.

calls.name: Aditya Birla Real Estate Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 construction cost: Rs 1,200-1,300 cr
calls.thesis: Real estate developer with net debt near zero post ITC sale; Q1 collections Rs 713 cr (+31% YoY) but net sales only ~Rs 329 cr with no launches and cancellations; BD still lagging against Rs 10,000-15,000 cr FY27 target.
calls.top: Net debt near zero post ITC sale

calls.name: Century Enka Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex FY27: over Rs 100 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin 15.5% flattered by Rs 46.24 cr one-time inventory gain; management reiterates 7-10% normalised margin, capacity flat until FY28, utilisation 85-90%.
calls.top: Inventory gain Rs 46.24 cr flatters quarter

calls.name: Triton Valves Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex FY27: ~15 cr
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 group sales up ~38% YoY to ~186.5 cr with tax-credit-boosted PAT, but EBITDA margin compressed on copper pass-through and climate control is weak; no capacity discipline, capex raised to ~15 cr.

calls.name: Ajmera Realty & Infra India Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 launch pipeline: around INR3,000 crores (Wadala boutique office ~INR3,600 crores single phase)
calls.thesis: Mumbai luxury/mid-market developer with Q1 revenue up 23% to INR320 crores and debt down to INR680 crores (D/E 0.47x), but Q1 sales of only INR146 crores and launches slipping, so supply-side evidence is thin.

calls.name: Digispice Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: Merger of DiGiSPICE into Spice Money / listing: completed by end of FY27 (March 2027) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Spice Money (DiGiSPICE) is an asset-light payments/banking-agent platform; AePS market share dipped to 17.93% in Q1 but recovered to 18.3% in July, with revenue flat and PAT Rs 6.6 crore. No supply-side capacity data; the read is mainly qualitative growth narrative.

calls.name: Mayur Uniquoters Ltd
calls.gLine: Top-line growth: 10-15% p.a. for next 3 years (3 years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 growth was ~25% revenue, but only ~2% volume; PVC lines run at 75-78% utilisation with no new capacity sanctioned beyond a 5 lakh metre line due Feb-Mar 2027, and export OEM price hikes remain unpushed.

calls.name: Seamec Ltd
calls.gLine: ANANT acquisition and deployment: Acquisition by end of Q1; deployment in Q3 (ONGC contract) (Q2-Q3 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 41% to INR 297 cr consolidated with ~42% EBITDA margin, but growth rests on Seamec ANANT acquisition (USD 70m, 50-50 equity/debt) and redeployment, with no fleet-addition capacity discipline or utilisation figure disclosed.
calls.top: Fleet growth via USD 70m vessel buy

calls.name: Ashapura Minechem Ltd
calls.gLine: Bauxite EBITDA per ton: USD 5.5-6 near term (Next 1-2 quarters)
calls.thesis: Guinea bauxite volumes fell to 2.34 Mt from 3.16 Mt in Q4 as freight shock hit; EBITDA/t rose to $6.3 from $5.9, but management guides ~$6 near term and expects no capex-led supply response.
calls.top: Bauxite volumes 2.34 Mt, down from 3.16 Mt

calls.name: Century Plyboards (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Particle board EBITDA margin: close to 15% (next year)
calls.thesis: Plywood volume and revenue surged on a 7% April price hike and pre-buying; management withdrew guidance, cited no large capex, and is tracking MDF margin toward 15%+ and particle board toward ~15% next year.
calls.top: No large capex planned near term

calls.name: Indoco Remedies Ltd
calls.gLine: Standalone EBITDA margin: double-digit for the year (aiming)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone EBITDA margin rebounded to 10.3% from 3.8% on 26% fewer batches and headcount cuts, but COGS up ~2pp from war-driven input inflation, US sterile plant still unaudited, and Europe/emerging primaries slipped.

calls.name: Kewal Kiran Clothing Ltd
calls.gLine: Other income: around Rs. 30 crores annualised (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue Rs 279 cr (+19% YoY) and EBITDA Rs 52 cr (+29%, margin >19%) on 24% volume growth, but standalone slowing, no capacity signals, and cotton inflation flagged as a margin headwind.
calls.top: Cotton inflation may hit GP margins

calls.name: Redington Ltd
calls.gLine: Q2 FY27 revenue: Expect good strong quarter
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 34% to INR34,966 cr and PAT up 77%, but management says ESG growth is largely price-led stock-and-sell with channel holding 2-3 months of inventory, and Arena losses persist.

calls.name: Page Industries Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +7.9% and PAT -4% on ~3 days of undelivered billing and input costs; management reiterates double-digit FY27 volume and 19-21% EBITDA margin, with a May price hike (2.2%) only partly covering input inflation.

calls.name: V2 Retail Ltd
calls.thesis: V2 Retail grew revenue 58% to INR997 cr with SSSG about 7.5% and 56 net stores added, but gross margin fell to 28.6% and management is pushing 4-5% price hikes from Q3 with 170-200 store openings still planned.

calls.name: Renaissance Global Ltd
calls.gLine: Working capital release: approx INR250 crores in FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +30% to INR690 cr and PAT up ~280%, but management is deliberately exiting INR300-400 cr of low-return customer-brand revenue to cut working capital by INR250 cr; growth guided lower.
calls.top: Revenue run rate to fall INR400 cr

calls.name: Man Infraconstruction Ltd
calls.thesis: Real estate developer with Q1 FY27 revenue up 8% to ₹218 cr and PAT up 29% to ₹72 cr, but Q1 pre-sales only ~₹290 cr against a ₹5,000 cr two-year target; no capacity or supply metrics apply.

calls.name: Cantabil Retail India Ltd
calls.gLine: Store openings Q2: 28-30 stores
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +13% to INR178.8 cr with SSG 4.04% and 667 stores; no supply discipline signal as store adds accelerate to 30 in Q2, and management reiterates INR1,000 cr FY27 target that needs ~18-19% growth.
calls.top: Q2 volume growth muted, H2 stronger

calls.name: GPT Infraprojects Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin FY27: 14% to 15% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue fell 9% to INR282 crores on West Bengal election labour disruption; management held FY27 30% growth and 14–15% margin guidance, which needs ~INR1,400 crores in the next nine months.

calls.name: Waaree Renewable Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin FY27: around 15%
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR924 cr (+53% YoY) on 889 MWp executed; INR5,300 cr unexecuted order book includes ~INR2,400 cr solar EPC and ~INR200 cr BESS, with no formal guidance given and consolidated margin diluted by T&D acquisition.

calls.name: Godrej Agrovet Ltd
calls.gLine: Astec revenue growth FY27: at least more than 20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Crop Care revenue fell 16.2% on a dry June and cotton herbicide weakness, while Oil Palm and Animal Nutrition grew; management still targets double-digit consolidated PBT growth, though it defers the number to end-September.

calls.name: Go Fashion (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Square feet growth FY27: 8% to 10% on year-through basis
calls.thesis: Go Colors Q1 FY27 shows first positive EBO SSSG (0.6%) and 66 store closures, but EBITDA fell 2% to INR67.4cr, inventory is INR245cr at ~100 days, and fabric costs are up 7–10% with no price hikes taken.
calls.top: Fabric cost up 7–10%, no price hike

calls.name: Gateway Distriparks Ltd
calls.gLine: Snowman pallet additions: around 24,000 pallets by end of year (FY27)
calls.thesis: Gateway's ICD volumes are flat YoY on the West Asia war, with management still guiding double-digit growth and calling market share intact; rail EBITDA per TEU is under pressure and double-stacking share dipped to 39% from 40–42%.

calls.name: Protean eGov Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin recovery: margins to stabilise from Q2 or Q3
calls.thesis: Q1FY27 revenue up 19% YoY to INR251 cr but EBITDA down 38% to INR28 cr (10% margin); management attributes ~INR18 cr to upfront RFP mandate costs and says normalised margin ~17.2%, with no capacity or supply-side signal.

calls.name: Innova Captab Ltd
calls.gLine: Jammu peak revenue: INR1,400 crores at 65-70% utilisation (long term)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 34% to INR470.9 cr with volume 20-22%, but Jammu ramp at 25-30% utilisation and only INR1-1.5 cr EBITDA; management reiterates 15-16% margin band and 20% volume growth guidance.

calls.name: Kalpataru Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 pre-sales: Rs 6,500 crore (~23% growth over FY26) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Real estate developer with pre-sales up 6% to Rs 1,329 cr, but realisations fell on mix, net debt flat at Rs 8,229 cr (2.0x) and profits deferred to H2 FY27 under completion accounting.

calls.name: Sambhv Steel Tubes Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth over FY26: 10-15% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 revenue INR732 crore and EBITDA INR100 crore with utilisation near limits, Kesda 3.6 lakh t stainless capacity due Q4 FY27 and FY27 EBITDA/ton guided 7,500-8,500 versus Q1 above 10,000.
calls.top: Stainless capacity 1.16 → 4.76 lakh t by Q4 FY27

calls.name: Amanta Healthcare Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: approx INR370 crores excl. SVP (FY27)
calls.thesis: SteriPort Line 3 commissioning slipped one quarter to late August on civil delays, pushing ~INR70 crores of contribution into FY27 and leaving the INR370 crore base case intact; margin guidance of 25-26% for FY28 rests on capacity still to be built.
calls.top: Price hike INR1.50 vs polymer cost INR2.25

calls.name: Seshaasai Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: IoT revenue share FY27: 15% to 18% of revenue
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 21.1% YoY but down 6.9% QoQ with gross margin 41.7% (from 44.5%) as COMC rose to 58.34%; management reiterates 8–12% revenue growth and H2-weighted margin recovery without numbers; capacity utilisation 65–70%.

calls.name: SKF India (Industrial) Ltd
calls.gLine: Underlying margin after one-offs: around 12%
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 sales Rs9,708m (+18.3% YoY on assumed comparison, +2.6% QoQ) but PBT margin ~9% on FX loss (~Rs147m) and ~Rs150m demerger IT costs; management guides 12% underlying and capacity-constrained until new Pune plant in 2028.
calls.top: Capex INR900-950cr for new Pune plant

calls.name: Symbiotec Pharmalab Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated revenue growth FY27: 20% (plus or minus 5%) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consol revenue INR218 cr (+7% YoY) and EBITDA INR45 cr, with the API core steady at 60%+ gross margin; new CDMO and injectable businesses drag INR23 cr opex and INR11 cr depreciation before revenue starts in H2.
calls.top: Capex INR200-250 cr per year for 2-3 years

calls.name: Bata India Ltd
calls.thesis: Bata Q1 FY27 turnover Rs979 cr (+4%) with 130bp gross margin gain, but management flagged 5-6% raw-material cost push, a 2,000-store EBO base and A&P rising to 3-3.5% of sales; no numeric forward guidance given.

calls.name: Kanpur Plastipack Ltd
calls.gLine: ESSEKAN premium PP yarn revenue: Rs 10 crore in FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA up 59% YoY to Rs 22.19 cr on 31% price rise vs 18% raw material rise, but FIBC volume fell to 3,000 t versus 3,500 t a year earlier and four-week order visibility limits confidence.

calls.name: Can Fin Homes Ltd
calls.gLine: Cost-to-income: around 19.5% for the year (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 disbursements beat at INR 2,609 crore (+29% YoY), but rundown rose to INR 1,857 crore, so AUM growth stayed ~10.8% against a 14% FY target; spread 2.83%, NIM 3.81%.

calls.name: Nava Ltd
calls.gLine: 100MW solar commissioning: by end of September 2026
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 record consolidated income of INR1,269 crores led by Zambia power (MEL 89.3% PLF), but Phase 2 thermal slipped to Q2 FY28 and metals sales dipped on Orissa shutdown.
calls.top: Phase 2 commissioning slips to Q2 FY28

calls.name: Shilpa Medicare Ltd
calls.gLine: Tax rate: Normalise around 25%
calls.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 revenue INR469 cr (+43% YoY) and 30% EBITDA margin, but management gave no numeric guidance, gross margin dipped on raw material costs, and capex is being held back in Biologics and Albumin for three years.
calls.top: No significant Biologics/Albumin capex for 3 years

calls.name: Arman Financial Services Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 AUM up 36% YoY to INR2,925 crores with PAT INR45 crores, but management stresses caution, volumes below expectation and credit cost guidance of 3-3.5% not formally given.

calls.name: Zydus Wellness Ltd
calls.gLine: Effective tax rate FY27: about 25% including deferred; cash 12-15% of 25% this year
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated sales INR 14,299m (+66.7% with Comfort Click consolidation); domestic grew only 4.6% as seasonal brands fell 12% and Nycil was hit by rain, with no supply-side or capacity signals discussed.

calls.name: Triveni Engineering & Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Sugar season 2026-27 operating performance: Significantly better operating season; Shamli bounce back expected
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 PBIT up on sugar and distillery margins, but distillery volumes fell 19% and crush fell 9%; sugar closing stock 3.59 lakh MT vs 4.45 lakh MT a year ago supports prices.

calls.name: Welspun Enterprises Ltd
calls.gLine: Order inflow FY27: INR8,000 crore to INR10,000 crore
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue soft at INR774 crore on execution delays, with 22.9% EBITDA margin and INR1,800 crore cash; management targets about 15% growth, closer to 15% than 20%, and order book slipped to INR18,700 crore.
calls.top: Q1 revenue soft; order book declined

calls.name: ZF Commercial Vehicle Control Systems India Ltd
calls.gLine: Services export growth: around 7.5% growth, expected to remain at this level
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 CV brake-systems maker grew sales 9.3% with CV>6T volumes +8.6% and aftermarket +15.6%, but reported PAT fell 14.7% on a prior-year FX gain; margins squeezed by aluminium and pass-through lags.

calls.name: PG Electroplast Ltd
calls.gLine: H2/FY27 RAC volume growth: 15-20% for 6 months; ~20%+ full year
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR2,034 cr (+35%) but operating margin 7.3% under commodity/rupee pressure; management targets ~8% FY27 margin and a compressor line plus 1.2 mn refrigerator plant adds capacity into a tightening import-restricted market.

calls.name: Speciality Restaurants Ltd
calls.gLine: Walters QSR store additions: 10 to 15 in FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Restaurant chain reports 11.35% same-store sales growth and gross margin up to 71.1% from 69.9%, but gives no numeric guidance on revenue or store count; store-opening plans are vague and capital cycle signals are mostly qualitative.

calls.name: Sharda Cropchem Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 volume growth: 5%-10% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +9% to Rs1,074 cr with volume -1.6% and FX +12.7%; Europe volumes fell on distributor destocking, while gross margin rose 120 bps to 36.7% and FY27 guidance held.

calls.name: Mallcom (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Sanand yearly turnover: Rs 40 crore minimum
calls.thesis: Mallcom Q1 FY27: revenue fell 25% QoQ to Rs 110 cr on export and port disruption, but margin rose to 12.51% on price pass-through; no capacity cut or capex discipline signal, and Rs 1,000 cr FY28 target kept despite admitted stretch.
calls.top: Revenue down 25% QoQ to Rs 110 cr

calls.name: PSP Projects Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1FY27 revenue up 65% to INR853 cr with EBITDA margin 6.42%; order book INR13,245 cr (up 103%) but ~70% within-group Adani, and management guides FY27 revenue INR4,400-4,500 cr with 7-8% margin only in H2.
calls.top: FY27 revenue held at INR4,400-4,500 cr

calls.name: Cohance Lifesciences Ltd
calls.gLine: Adjusted EBITDA margin: Near prior-year margin for FY27, accelerating from FY28 (FY27-FY28)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 was the trough: consolidated revenue INR4,223m (-23% YoY), adjusted EBITDA margin 2.2%, with management guiding sequential recovery in Q2 and YoY growth only from H2.

calls.name: G R Infraprojects Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex: ~INR300 cr FY27; INR200-250 cr FY28 (FY27-FY28)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue up 32.7% to INR2,423 cr but standalone EBITDA margin fell to 11.02% from 12.65%; FY27 growth guide held at 15-20% and margin at 10-11%, with order book ~INR25,300 cr.

calls.name: Supriya Lifescience Ltd
calls.gLine: EU audit Ambernath: second half of November (Nov 2026)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 190 cr (+31% YoY) but EBITDA margin fell to 25% on water and solar-power costs; management reiterates Rs 1,000 cr and 33-35% margin guidance, with Rs 35 cr sales deferred and Rs 230-240 cr inventory to liquidate.

calls.name: Archean Chemical Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Salt volume growth: double-digit YoY growth from Q3 (Q3 FY27 onwards)
calls.thesis: Bromine volumes 4,175 t (below ~4,500 t run-rate) with realisations ~INR300/kg, but bromine spot prices falling 30-40% in China and salt volumes down 12% on logistics; Q1 margin recovery is partly offset by execution misses.

calls.name: Senco Gold Ltd
calls.gLine: New stores: 12-15 more in FY27 (remainder FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 67% with retail +50% and SSSG ~39%, but reported EBITDA fell to 7.0% (from 10.1%) and management retained 7.5-7.8% guidance; supply-side signals (inventory days ~152, hedging held at ~50%) are mixed.

calls.name: Redtape Ltd
calls.gLine: New store openings FY27: 150+ stores (aspiration)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 PAT up 19.4% to INR47 crore on 3.7% standalone revenue growth, driven by no price hikes and retail mix; e-commerce fell to 22% of sales from 30% as management refused deeper discounting.

calls.name: India Shelter Finance Corporation Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1FY27 PAT ₹143 cr (+23% YoY) and ROE 17.5% held, but Stage 3 rose to 1.5% and management guides only a Q3 turn; disbursement cut to ₹641 cr by a one-time recognition change.

calls.name: Concord Enviro Systems Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth (2 years): 15-20% then 20-25% growth (next two to three years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell to INR853m from INR1,024m with EBITDA at minus INR149m on Middle East supply disruption; management guides growth from H2 on a INR699 crore order book, with no hard numerical FY27 guidance.

calls.name: Belrise Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth (company): mid-teens (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 manufacturing revenue +20% YoY to INR21,979m but EBITDA margin 11.5% and mgmt offers no supply-side data; capacity expansion (four new facilities) and INR17,000m QIP deployment point to a capex-heavy, acquisition-led growth phase.
calls.top: Four new facilities ramping, fixed costs ahead of revenue

calls.name: Vikran Engineering Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue from operations: INR2,300–2,500 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 standalone revenue INR204 cr (+28%) with consolidated revenue only INR141.6 cr after NOPL consolidation; H2-weighted FY27 guide of INR2,300–2,500 cr and receivables (debtor days ~296) remain the key unproven items.

calls.name: Dev Accelerator Ltd
calls.gLine: Signed pipeline conversion: 2.31m sq ft signed for future consumption; 8,500 seats at Ahmedabad DM project (FY27)
calls.thesis: Flex-workspace operator adding capacity: 1.13m sq ft operational, 91.93% occupancy, but Q1 consolidated revenue INR 53.8 cr with leverage flattered by excluding ~INR 226 cr lease liabilities, and supply is debt-funded expansion.

calls.name: Infinity Infoway Ltd
calls.gLine: ZeroTouch share of revenue: 20% to 22% within about two years
calls.thesis: Small-cap AI/ERP SaaS story with Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 689 lakh, EBITDA Rs 344 lakh; no capacity or pricing data, ZeroTouch has only pilot orders and 150 machines built, and the Rs 75 crore order book is unverified.

calls.name: Pine Labs Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue growth about 20% y/y with contribution margin dipping on upfront investments and low-margin device sales; management guides FY27 CM back to 73-74% and EBITDA margin not below FY26 23.5%.

calls.name: Park Medi World Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue FY27: Rs.2,080 crores (+24%) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Capacity is ramping to 4,740 beds by FY27 and 5,740 by FY28 while occupancy fell to 56% from 68%, so supply is outrunning demand; FY27 guidance of 24% revenue growth and ARPOB +10-12% is management's case.

calls.name: Sarda Energy & Minerals Ltd
calls.gLine: IPP annual PLF / generation: better than FY26 (415 crore units)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 PAT ₹478 cr (+9.4% YoY) flattered by ₹110 cr one-off regulatory benefit; no FY27 guidance given, with management pointing to better July power prices (₹5/unit IEX vs ₹4.20) and hydro recovery.

calls.name: Rathi Steel & Power Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin improvement: 2-3% improvement over two years
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volumes up ~30% to 28,372 MT with TMT doubling, but stainless volumes fell 10-12% and EBITDA margin stays ~4%; utilisation only ~51-52% in FY26, guided >60%.

calls.name: Talbros Automotive Components Ltd
calls.gLine: Exports share FY28: 35%
calls.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 revenue of INR242 crore (+15% YoY) and EBITDA margin 17.6%, but supply-side evidence is thin: no capacity-discipline signal, margin pressure from steel/aluminium and wages, and forging guidance cut from ~INR400 crore to ~INR340 crore.
calls.top: Forging FY27 revenue cut to ~INR340 crore

calls.name: Supreme Industries Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volume fell ~14% to 1,57,536 t on polymer-driven channel destocking, yet management reiterated 12–13% FY27 volume growth and 14–14.5% EBITDA margin, with July described as "excellent growth".

calls.name: Rico Auto Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: more than INR3,200 crores (~INR3,250 cr) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up ~39% to INR755 cr but EBITDA margin fell to 4.6% and PAT turned to a INR3.4 cr loss on air freight and aluminium settlement lag; capex being curtailed after 54 projects.

calls.name: Natco Pharma Ltd
calls.gLine: Domestic volume growth: about 25% in volumes (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell to INR794 cr from INR1,391 cr on lower Lenalidomide; margin 30.9% was lifted by a seasonal Adcock flu-season bump, and management reaffirmed ~INR750 cr PAT guidance with no supply-side change.
calls.top: Brazil revenue up 180% to INR178 cr

calls.name: Engineers India Ltd
calls.gLine: Consultancy turnover growth FY27: at least 10% growth on INR3,850 crore base
calls.thesis: Consultancy-led margin story: Q1 FY27 PBT up 55% to INR145 crore on consultancy segment profit of 24%, but turnkey revenue fell to INR302 crore from INR449 crore and order inflow was only INR514 crore against an INR8,000 crore annual target.
calls.top: Q1 order inflow only INR514 crore

calls.name: Subex Ltd
calls.thesis: Subex Q1 FY27 revenue INR 79.45 cr (+8.9% QoQ, +19.7% YoY) with 21.2% EBITDA margin, but management is signalling margin reinvestment, no numeric guidance, and Middle East order slowdown.

calls.name: Gallantt Ispat Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA Rs203 cr (18% margin, Rs8,787/t) flat QoQ but down YoY on pellet shutdown and coal; 0.23 mt expansion guided H2 FY27, mines FY28, no supply cut or deferral.
calls.top: TMT prices corrected sharply in Q1

calls.name: Firstsource Solutions Ltd
calls.industry: Business Process Outsourcing (BPO)/ Knowledge Process Outsourcing (KPO)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +12.3% cc YoY with margin 12.4% but a healthcare BPaaS deramp (~1-1.5% of revenue) and INR717m exceptional charges; FY27 guidance held, no capacity signals.

calls.name: Kirloskar Oil Engines Ltd
calls.thesis: Standalone revenue up 16% to INR1,461 cr but EBITDA margin fell to 11.2% from 13.5% on commodity costs and lagged price realisation; management guides to 3-6 month recovery with no numeric guidance.

calls.name: Imagicaaworld Entertainment Ltd
calls.gLine: Park additions: about one park every year; 12 parks by 2030 (FY30)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +20% to INR178 cr and EBITDA +24% to INR90 cr, but ARPU flat near INR1,395 and management admits softer ticket pricing to buy footfall; supply additions (Indore, Mehsana, Hello Park) are growing capacity alongside.

calls.name: Mahanagar Gas Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex FY27: INR1,500-1,800 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: MGL's Q1 FY27 volumes rose 7% YoY to 4.766 mmscmd and EBITDA jumped to INR343 crore, but management admits gas costs may spike and margins will be under pressure for 1-2 months.

calls.name: Ujjivan Small Finance Bank Ltd
calls.thesis: Management transition call, not an operating read: MD/CEO early exit on health grounds, Carol Furtado interim, FY27 guidance reiterated with no numbers; capital raise timing unquantified, supply-side evidence absent.

calls.name: Borosil Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin FY27 (ex other income): about 18%
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 9% to INR253.6 cr but EBITDA margin fell to 14.6% from 17.8% on West Asia fuel/packaging inflation (~INR10 cr hit); price pass-through lags into Q2, and FY27 capex guided INR125–150 cr.

calls.name: SMC Global Securities Ltd
calls.gLine: Net interest margin: Grow gradually over coming years
calls.thesis: Broking-led growth with consolidated revenue up 21.2% to ₹515.1 cr and PAT ₹36.7 cr, but NBFC AUM fell to ₹1,025 cr from ₹1,118 cr and the prior 25% AUM growth guidance was missed.
calls.top: NBFC AUM down QoQ to ₹1,025 cr

calls.name: Chemplast Sanmar Ltd
calls.gLine: PVC-VCM spread: EBITDA neutral at $120-130; PBT positive another $20-30
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA loss of INR115 crores on high-cost VCM; management sees PVC-VCM spread near $160 from September but gave no numeric profitability guidance, with CMCD order book and R32 ramp as offsets.

calls.name: Sula Vineyards Ltd
calls.gLine: Net debt trend: lower by end FY27 vs FY26
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 3% to INR121 cr but gross profit down 5%; grape-mix (~150bp) and geographic-mix (~200bp) hit margins, with management guiding recovery from Q4 FY27 and normalisation by Q1 FY28.
calls.top: Gross profit down 5% on 3% revenue growth

calls.name: IKIO Technologies Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +41% YoY to Rs169cr and EBITDA margin 13%, but management concedes gross margin fell to ~41% on metals and semiconductor cost/lead-time shocks, and capacity is ahead of demand with only Rs20-25cr capex left.

calls.name: Blue Jet Healthcare Ltd
calls.gLine: Iodinated intermediate commercial batches: positive trend by end Q2 or beginning Q3
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR293 cr (+25% QoQ) on PI/API restart, but contrast media fell ~40% QoQ on ~INR30 cr goods-in-transit; plant utilisation steady at 70-odd percent with capex ~INR250 cr in FY27.
calls.top: Goods in transit up ~INR30 cr QoQ

calls.name: Le Travenues Technology Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 GTV up 19% to Rs 5,524 cr and PAT up 81%, but adjusted EBITDA fell 7% as management reinvests in hotels and AI; flights volume hit by airline capacity cuts.

calls.name: JSW Cement Ltd
calls.gLine: North EBITDA breakeven: Q2 FY27 at EBITDA level (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volumes up 15% to 3.81Mt with North ramp, but consolidated EBITDA fell 7.5% YoY to INR299cr on fuel costs and INR33cr North marketing; North utilisation 55%, company guides high-teens FY27 volume growth.
calls.top: GGBS growth cut to high single digits

calls.name: Excelsoft Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: INR350-360 crore
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 44% to INR802.63m with EBITDA margin down to 16.24% from 18.02%; management guides 24-25% FY27 EBITDA margin, a cut from the earlier ~30% view, and FY27 revenue of INR350-360 crore.

calls.name: Asset Reconstruction Company (India) Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 recovery-led quarter: recoveries up 151% to INR1,066 crores, but acquisitions fell to INR353 crores and standalone PAT of INR143 crores was flattered by INR120 crores of write-backs; no numeric guidance given.
calls.top: Acquisitions INR353 crores, down ~INR150 crores YoY

calls.name: GHCL Ltd
calls.gLine: Vacuum salt and bromine revenue at optimal utilisation: INR150-170 crore revenue, 40-45% EBITDA margin
calls.thesis: Soda ash cycle still weak: management calls Q1 margin of 29.1% transient, guides to normalisation, and gives no greenfield timeline, with Chinese capacity cash-loss-making but no meaningful cut yet.

calls.name: LMW Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 PBT up 151% YoY to ₹85 cr on flat sequential revenue, but machine tool and textile machinery volumes are soft, with textile utilisation around 60% and MTD capacity at 75–80%.

calls.name: Sumeet Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 PAT margin: 3.5% to 4% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin collapsed to 3.24% (EBITDA INR8.85 cr) on PTA/MEG volatility and a 15-day maintenance shutdown; management guides FY27 revenue +30%, EBITDA ~6%, PAT 3.5–4%, with Nakoda CP plant now slipping to next FY.

calls.name: Praj Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Praj GenX EBITDA breakeven: by end of FY27
calls.thesis: Praj's Q1 FY27 shows order intake of INR 10 billion and backlog of INR 45.9 billion, but first-gen ethanol greenfield slowdown, funding delays and rising material costs keep conversion and margins weak.

calls.name: Sanghvi Movers Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 revenue +39% YoY to Rs 380 cr but EBITDA margin fell to 35% from 40% QoQ; core crane margin 47% vs 53%, with receivables ageing (DSO 116 days) and FY27 EBITDA guidance held at Rs 525-575 cr.

calls.name: Transport Corporation of India Ltd
calls.gLine: Seaways EBITDA margin Q2: 25-30% (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue up ~9% with standalone ~7% and EBITDA margins flat; supply-chain growth slowed, Seaways bunker costs compress margins, and guidance (10-12% freight, 12-15% supply chain) rests on H2 pipeline.

calls.name: Cera Sanitaryware Ltd
calls.gLine: Brand-building spend FY27: INR 85 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +19.5% on volume, but EBITDA margin fell to 10.1% (vs 13.1%); management attributes ~4.35pts to one-offs and reiterates 13.5–14% FY27 margin and 18–20% growth, with sanitaryware utilisation at just 61%.

calls.name: Datamatics Global Services Ltd
calls.gLine: 3-year revenue target: About INR 3,000 cr over 3 years, from ~INR 2,000 cr (3 years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 9.9% to INR 513.9 cr and EBITDA margin up 343 bps to 19.7%, but no capacity or capex signals; growth tied to AI deal wins and management reiterates high-single-digit FY27 guidance.

calls.name: NBCC (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Standalone FY27 revenue: INR 13,000-14,000 cr (FY27)
calls.thesis: Standalone EBITDA up 62% to INR 160 cr (margin 8.77%) on marketing fees, but revenue grew only 10% and order inflow of INR 1,700 cr lags the INR 18,000-20,000 cr targeted for next 2-3 quarters.

calls.name: Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Ltd
calls.gLine: Ethnic portfolio revenue growth FY27: 20% plus (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR2,026 cr (+11%) and EBITDA margin 8.2%, with TCNS like-to-like only ~2% and a sizeable TMRW loss; no capacity or supply-side signal, and cost inflation of ~4% is flagged to hit Q2–Q3 margins.

calls.name: Inox Wind Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue ₹872 cr with flat YoY growth as Inox Wind pivots from turnkey EPC to equipment supply; management reiterates 75% FY27 revenue growth and 20–22% EBITDA margin, H2-loaded, with little Q1 evidence.

calls.name: Mitsu Chem Plast Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth: Quarter-on-quarter growth similar to recent quarters (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin jumped to 16.29% (from 5.87%) on mix and efficiency, but management still guides 10–12% sustainable; utilisation 64% in FY26 while a 3,550 MTPA expansion is announced, with cost pass-through of raw materials.

calls.name: Maximus International Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 consolidated revenue: above INR 200 crore (conservative) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up ~52% to INR59.91 cr but EBITDA margin fell to 7.64% from 9.81% on Middle East war input costs; plant utilisation only ~45% of 50,000 KL, so supply is not the constraint.

calls.name: CL Educate Ltd
calls.gLine: VIRSA revenue growth FY27: 45-50%
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell about ₹17.5 crore on a full-quarter basis while cost cuts of about ₹18 crore lifted EBITDA margin to 16.6%, but PAT stayed negative and test prep volumes are still churning.

calls.name: Indian Energy Exchange Ltd
calls.gLine: RTM volume growth: 25-30% CAGR (CEO gut feel) (medium term)
calls.thesis: IEX Q1 FY27 volume rose 16% to 37.5 BU and PAT 134.8 crore (+12%), but the Grid India market-coupling order threatens the core DAM franchise and management gave no timeline.

calls.name: RITES Ltd
calls.gLine: Export revenue FY27: not less than INR 300 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: RITES order book grew to INR 9,450 crore with 128 orders worth INR 670 crore, but ~70% of fresh inflows are competitive and EBITDA margin held at 22% against a 20% red line amid pressure from mix, travel and pay revision.

calls.name: Tarsons Products Ltd
calls.gLine: Panchla/Amta contribution to standalone revenue FY28: 20-25% of standalone revenue (FY28)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +21% YoY to Rs 86 cr standalone with gross margin down to 67.1% on 25-50% input cost spikes; capacity still commissioning with debt at Rs 380 cr gross and no major capex planned.

calls.name: Venus Pipes & Tubes Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin FY27: <17% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 16% to INR320.5 cr but EBITDA margin flat at 16.1%; management guides sub-17% FY27 margin and 18% in two years, with welded utilisation only ~60% and seamless ~85-90%.

calls.name: Virtuoso Optoelectronics Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR 376.6 cr (+85% YoY) with EBITDA margin ~9.3% flat QoQ; compressor utilisation only ~50% and AC capacity 1.0→1.8m sets with 50-60% FY28 utilisation planned, so capacity additions outrun demand visibility.

calls.name: Orkla India Ltd
calls.thesis: Orkla India Q1 FY27 revenue up 11.5% with volume only 1.7% (4.4% ex-Kerala) as spice inflation of 32.8% was passed through; pricing contributed 11.4%, EBITDA margin 17.5%.

calls.name: Aequs Ltd
calls.thesis: Aerospace order book crossed USD1,004m (+13% QoQ) and revenue +40% YoY, but consumer utilisation fell to ~22% and operational EBITDA of INR148m still leans on a Q4 FY27 consumer breakeven that needs utilisation to rise to 40-50%.

calls.name: NCC Ltd
calls.gLine: Order inflow FY27: INR 22,000-25,000 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consol revenue up 12% to INR 5,842 cr with EBITDA 9.4%, but FY27 guidance of 8-10% growth and 8.5-9% margin implies slower rest of year; debt rising to INR 4,020 cr consol on smart-meter loans.

calls.name: Banswara Syntex Ltd
calls.gLine: Garment revenue run-rate: about INR100 crore per quarter for next 3 quarters
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 4% with yarn utilisation at 70% and garment dispatches slipped; management holds FY27 INR1,450-1,500 crore guidance and a 12% EBITDA target, with INR140 crore capex sanctioned, while Q1 consolidated EBITDA was 9%.

calls.name: Arihant Superstructures Ltd
calls.gLine: Deliveries FY27: 2,500 units by end of FY27
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 presales up 15% YoY to INR 173 crore on flat INR 7,500/sq ft pricing, while blended margin fell to ~9% and management guides only modest growth with no new land buys.

calls.name: Sudarshan Chemical Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Legacy Sudarshan growth: 12% to 13% (FY2027)
calls.thesis: Acquired Heubach/Clariant pigment group posted business EBITDA of Rs128 Cr (6-7% margin) with guidance of EUR700m turnover and EUR35m EBITDA held, not raised, pending Q2; volume growth unclear and supply discipline not discussed.
calls.top: Working capital stretched by safety stock

calls.name: Eldeco Housing & Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Legacy inventory liquidation FY27: 40% to 60% of ~INR 75 cr
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 profit spike driven by one horizontal project (Imperia Phase 2, ~60% gross margin on 85% of revenue); bookings fell to INR 105.7 cr with no supply-discipline evidence, and FY28 guidance is only qualitative.

calls.name: Jammu & Kashmir Bank Ltd
calls.gLine: ROA: 1.25% plus
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 profit fell to INR424 crore on higher standard-asset provisions and costlier bulk deposits used to fund competitive corporate lending; management kept FY27 guidance (NIM ~3.5%, GNPA <2.25%) but signals credit growth of 18-20% and a 1.25%+ ROA.

calls.name: HT Media Ltd
calls.thesis: Print yield-led growth lifted consolidated revenue 15% to INR 497 cr and EBITDA ~3x to INR 90 cr, but a dilutive preferential issue at ~INR 24.7 and newsprint at $650-700/t cloud the quality of the recovery.

calls.name: Hindustan Media Ventures Ltd
calls.thesis: Consolidated revenue up 15% to INR 497 crore and EBITDA near 3x to INR 90 crore, but the quarter is flattered by treasury and asset-sale gains, digital is shrinking, and a below-book preferential issue is dilutive to minority holders.
calls.top: Preferential issue to retire 30-50% of debt

calls.name: Schneider Electric Infrastructure Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 orders hit a record INR 915 crore but EBIT fell to INR 32 crore on commodity-driven gross margin squeeze from legacy fixed-price orders; management gave no numeric guidance and pricing actions are yet to fructify.
calls.top: Gross margin hit by legacy fixed-price orders

calls.name: Brahmaputra Infrastructure Ltd
calls.gLine: Order book target by FY27 year-end: Rs 2,500 cr (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue up 20.2% YoY to Rs 110.79 cr on a Rs 1,600 cr order book, but management gave no capacity or capex data and cash conversion and OCCPS overhang remain unresolved.
calls.top: Order book Rs 1,600 cr+ over 18-30 months

calls.name: Orient Cement Ltd
calls.gLine: Capacity utilisation target: 70% to 75% (medium term)
calls.thesis: Ambuja Cements Q1 FY27 call (filed by Orient): volumes fell (trade -2%, non-trade -21% YoY), ~6.5 Mt of old capacity suspended, cost down INR206/t to INR4,241 but NSP weak and utilisation ~65%.

calls.name: Captain Polyplast Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin trajectory: 10-15 bps blended improvement every quarter as Ahmedabad ramps
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 growth and margin improved (EBITDA +26.7%, margin 12.07%, +99bps) on micro-irrigation volumes and solar pump orders, but polymer costs up 30-35% and working capital is stretched into H2.

calls.name: Best Agrolife Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin (FY27, indicative): 13%-14% sustainable
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA rose 70% to Rs 78 cr (20% margin) on mix and pricing, but revenue grew only 4% and management withdrew near-term growth guidance, with capex on hold and ~Rs 60 cr sales-return provision.

calls.name: Apex Frozen Foods Ltd
calls.gLine: RTE share of volume: at least 20% in FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 margin jump (EBITDA margin 12.7% vs 7.1%) came from price, not volume: realisation ~INR930/kg (+15%) while shrimp volume fell to 2,624 MT from 3,015 MT and utilisation stayed ~38%.

calls.name: Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation Ltd
calls.gLine: Non-convenience fee: return to INR150 crore per quarter
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 18.1% to INR1,370 crore led by catering (+34%), but EBITDA fell 2.8% to INR386 crore and margin dipped to 28.2% on one-offs, HR cost and a 30% resin-driven squeeze in Rail Neer; no supply-side capacity signal from IRCTC itself.

calls.name: Windlas Biotech Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR248 crores (+18% YoY) with CDMO +29% to INR207 crores, but Trade Generics fell to INR30 crores after codeine exit and management gave no numeric guidance; Plant 6 due end-H1 with ~INR1,100 crores revenue capacity claimed.
calls.top: Trade Generics INR30 crores after codeine exit

calls.name: eMudhra Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin FY27: around 25%, PAT 16-16.5% (FY27)
calls.thesis: eMudhra Q1 FY27 grew total income 28% to INR 1,925m with EBITDA margin 26.2%, but Trust token supply stalled on CCA ePass recertification, with ~INR 5-7 crore volume lost and Q2 top-line likely still soft.
calls.top: ePass token recertification pending with CCA

calls.name: Allied Blenders and Distillers Ltd
calls.gLine: Margin benefit from backward integration: ~300bp by FY28, further 100bp by FY29 (FY28-FY29)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volume +6.2% and gross margin +277bp to 46%, but reported EBITDA flat at ₹120cr due to ₹24cr supply-chain hit; FY27 margin guided flat to FY26 with price hikes only hoped for, not confirmed.
calls.top: Margin guide FY27 flat to FY26

calls.name: Brainbees Solutions Ltd
calls.gLine: Gross margin recovery: fully recover crude/rupee pass-through by end of Q2
calls.thesis: India multi-channel revenue grew 17.7% but gross margin fell 280 bps in Q4 and recovered only 20 bps in Q1, with diapering price competition and crude-linked pass-through driving the squeeze; consolidated adj. EBITDA margin fell to 4.24% from 4.98%.
calls.top: India gross margin down 280 bps in Q4

calls.name: Mach Travel Solutions Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR144.33 cr (+538% YoY) but EBITDA margin fell to 6.09% from 7.17%, management admits markup cuts for aggressive market share and working-capital strain requires bank OD.
calls.top: Working capital strain, bank OD being sought

calls.name: Western Carriers (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex FY27: approx INR100 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 12% to INR465 cr and PAT INR9 cr on domestic volume growth of 37%, but EXIM freight spikes, 111 working-capital days and an unchanged 4.1% EBITDA margin show pricing has not been passed through.
calls.top: EXIM freight 3-4x; no price hike discussed

calls.name: Carraro India Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: up to 10% YoY if situation stabilises (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 10% to INR5,447m but EBITDA margin 10.4% on unrecovered commodity and freight costs; management guides pass-through over 12 months with no quantified margin target beyond ~50bp uplift.
calls.top: Commodity cost gap not yet recovered

calls.name: National Securities Depository Ltd
calls.industry: Depositories, Clearing Houses and Other Intermediaries
calls.gLine: Operating leverage to normalise margins: normalised margins over medium term
calls.thesis: NSDL Q1 FY27 standalone PAT up 7.9% to INR89.1 crore while EBITDA margin moderated to 57.8% on front-loaded tech and headcount spend; incremental demat share rose to 17.6% from about 14%.

calls.name: Highway Infrastructure Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 turnover: INR 850 crore (INR 700 crore toll, rest EPC) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA just INR 4.8 crore and PAT INR 1.1 crore on toll traffic hit; management guides FY27 turnover INR 850 crore with no supply-side or capex disclosure, so the read is weak and unverified.
calls.top: Q1 EBITDA INR 4.8 crore, PAT INR 1.1 crore

calls.name: VMS TMT Ltd
calls.gLine: Sales growth: 10% to 15% annually (annual)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 16% y/y to INR247.88 cr but EBITDA fell about 41% on imported scrap cost and forex; TMT utilisation near 80%, with management guiding margin recovery only from Q3.
calls.top: EBITDA down ~41% y/y on scrap costs

calls.name: Meenakshi India Ltd
calls.gLine: Capacity utilisation FY27: close to 70% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Reported profit driven by Rs 711 lakh other income (incl. Rs 373 lakh unrealised fair value gain); core garment EBITDA margin only ~3.4% on flat revenue of Rs 3,224 lakh, with tariff-driven US discounts still weighing.
calls.top: US discounts given to retain customers

calls.name: Gaja Alternative Asset Management Ltd
calls.thesis: Asset manager with 100% fee and performance economics; Q1 FY27 PAT up 35% to INR27.2 crore, but performance income (INR29.7 crore) is lumpy and management declined to give forward guidance.

calls.name: ESDS Software Solution Ltd
calls.gLine: Own GPU deployment: ~1,500 GPUs by Jan/Feb 2027 (mid-to-end Q4)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up only 7.3% YoY to INR133.66 cr with GPU capacity (Sharon AI, 8,200 B300s) not billing until Q3; the story rests on unproven GPU leasing and heavy customer-advance funding.
calls.top: Sharon AI GPU billing slipped to Q3

calls.name: Whirlpool of India Ltd
calls.thesis: Record Q1 revenue of INR 2,582 crore (+26%) with standalone EBITDA margin squeezed to 4.6% by war-led oil and forex costs and e-waste accruals; management gave no numeric guidance.

calls.name: Gujarat Narmada Valley Fertilizers & Chemicals Ltd
calls.gLine: Incremental revenue from projects under execution: INR1,200-1,500 crore (post project completion)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 profit second-highest in company history after Q1 FY22 on war-driven realisations, but offtake weak, 15% of June inventory liquidated by July, and plants shut for viability.
calls.top: June inventory only 15% liquidated by July

calls.name: Sanofi India Ltd
calls.thesis: Diabetes growing ~14% in Q2 FY27 with insulin share strong, but partnership-channel sales are flat at 2% growth and management does not expect industry growth in 2026, so the top line is weak and mainly diabetes-driven.
calls.top: One-off safety stock base effect in Q1

calls.name: Avanti Feeds Ltd
calls.gLine: Feed sales FY27 (MT): around 5,85,000 MTs (FY27)
calls.thesis: Feed volumes up sharply (Q1 FY27 feed sales 1,93,852 MT vs 1,23,725 in Q4) but feed PBT margin fell to 7.06% from ~13% as fish meal and soya prices spiked; a ~10% price hike taken in June-July is the only offset.

calls.name: Shakti Pumps India Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue: INR5,000 crores in three years (FY29) (FY29)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 37.9% to INR859 cr and volumes up 57.6%, but EBITDA margin ~9.6% on ~10% YoY raw-material and realisation squeeze; capacity build (0.5 GW, 2.2 GW) with utilisation at 63%.
calls.top: EBITDA impact ~10% YoY from costs and realisation

calls.name: Thomas Scott (India) Ltd
calls.thesis: Digital apparel retailer with no capacity-discipline signal; Q1 revenue +22% to INR 66 cr with EBITDA margin 13.07%, but growth was bought via marketing and wholesale aggregator sales, and a fire-insurance claim keeps debt elevated.
calls.top: Finance cost ~3x YoY on working capital

calls.name: Prime Fresh Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: 7% to 7.5% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 sales up 15.7% to INR81.71 crores and EBITDA margin 9.83%, but management itself flagged one-offs, guides EBITDA 7-7.5%, and receivables are about a third of sales with INR7-8 crore slow-moving debtors.

calls.name: S Chand and Company Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs1,145m (+12% YoY) with EBITDA loss Rs97m; management reiterated 10–15% growth and 17–19% EBITDA margin guidance, while stockpiling ~25% of annual paper needs ahead of price rises, lifting working capital.

calls.name: Sigachi Industries Ltd
calls.thesis: MCC realisation jumped to INR241/kg from INR216 but utilisation is only 76.8% and Q1 revenue of INR121 cr is far short of the INR650-675 cr guidance, which management says is unchanged.

calls.name: Ddev Plastiks Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: BESS EBITDA margin (supply phase): 6% to 8% (initial phase)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA crossed INR100 crores at 10% margin on war-driven export price premium; utilisation fell to about 66% as 48,000 t Bhiwadi XLPE capacity ramps slowly, with FY27 volume growth guided at 15%.

calls.name: HMA Agro Industries Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue INR 2,072 crore (~90% YoY) and PAT INR 31.9 crore, but no capacity, utilisation or pricing disclosure; growth attributed to buffalo meat exports with unexplained other income surge.

calls.name: NIIT Learning Systems Ltd
calls.gLine: Q2 revenue growth YoY: 9% to 11% (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 reported growth of 25% is mostly acquisitions and a lapping RECO contract; organic constant-currency growth is 5% YoY and 2.9% QoQ, with FY27 high-single-digit guidance and margin 18-20%.

calls.name: Jupiter Life Line Hospitals Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA INR79.3 crores at 19.3% margin with Dombivli drag INR9.5 crores; occupancy diluted to 59.6% by new beds, guidance on Dombivli loss held at INR2-3 crores per month with no raise.
calls.top: Occupancy diluted to 59.6% by Dombivli beds

calls.name: Unimech Aerospace and Manufacturing Ltd
calls.gLine: Gross block by end FY27: approximately double current (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR108 cr (+71% YoY) with 58% plant utilisation, yet management is pulling capex forward and gross block to double by FY27 on Saudi JV, aerospace qualifications and Hobel; supply is expanding ahead of confirmed demand.
calls.top: Capex pulled forward; gross block ~2x by FY27

calls.name: Stallion India Fluorochemicals Ltd
calls.gLine: Peak revenue FY28: exceeding 1100 crore (FY28)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 profit spike (PAT +79% to ₹18.57 cr) is partly one-off: management says ~50% came from inventory gains and called the quarter "special"; R32 plant slipped from Dec-26 target and FY27 contribution cut from ₹250 cr, with new equity/debt raise now under consideration.

calls.name: Network People Services Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: International revenue share: around 50% in about 2 years
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue about INR 61.4 crore, down quarter-on-quarter from about INR 68 crore, yet management reiterated 60-70% annual growth and about 30% EBITDA margin with no numbers on supply or capex.
calls.top: Q1 revenue down QoQ to INR 61.42 crore

calls.name: Sugs Lloyd Ltd
calls.gLine: Peak FY27 borrowing: around INR130 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 32% to INR78.4 cr with 15.3% EBITDA margin, but receivables of INR149 cr and borrowings rising from INR68 cr to INR91 cr make working capital the swing factor against the INR1,000 cr FY28 target.

calls.name: Fabtech Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: Top line by 2030: Rs1,000 crore plus (2030)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 10% to Rs74.98 cr and PAT turned to Rs4.21 cr from a loss, but the EPC model is H2-weighted, receivables rose to ~Rs215 cr, and capacity and supply signals are absent.
calls.top: Receivables ~Rs215 cr vs Rs211 cr in March

calls.name: Purple Style Labs Ltd
